adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the branch where a `destination` has no `credentialId` calls `createEvent(c, event)` (no third arg). But `createEvent` was changed to accept an optional `externalId` and returns it on the `EventResult` (`CalendarManager.createEvent` now includes `externalId` in the result). EventManager later persists `externalCalendarId` from `result.externalId`, so this path will store `externalCalendarId: undefined` despite having `destination.externalId` available. This is diff-verifiable and can break correct calendar targeting/updates/deletes, especially since `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent` now selects the calendar by matching `destinationCalendar[].credentialId` and otherwise falls back to `primary`.
